The '''2012–13 [[Super League Greece]]''' was the 77th season of the highest [[Association football|football]] league of [[Greece]] and the seventh under the name Super League. The season started on 25 August 2012 and ended on 2 June 2013 with the last matches of the play-off round. [[Olympiacos F.C.|Olympiacos]] were the defending champions, having won their 39th Greek championship in the [[2011–12 Super League Greece|2011–12 season]]. They successfully defended their crown, finishing 15 points ahead of second-placed [[PAOK FC|PAOK]].

The league comprised 13 teams from the 2011–12 season and three promoted teams from the [[2011–12 Football League (Greece)|2011–12 Football League]].

==Teams==
Three teams were relegated at the end of the [[2011–12 Super League Greece|2011–12 season]]. [[Ergotelis F.C.|Ergotelis]], [[Panetolikos F.C.|Panetolikos]] and [[Doxa Drama F.C.|Doxa Drama]] would compete to the [[2012–13 Football League (Greece)|2012–13 Football League]].

Three teams were promoted from the [[2011–12 Football League (Greece)|2011–12 Football League]]. The champions, [[Panthrakikos F.C.|Panthrakikos]], the runners-up [[Veria F.C.|Veria]] and the winners of the promotion play-offs, [[Platanias F.C.|Platanias]]. Panthrakikos and Veria returned to top level respectively two and four years after relegation, while Platanias made their debut.

==Play-offs==
In the play-off for Champions League, the four qualified teams play each other in a home and away [[Round-robin tournament|round robin]]. However, they do not all start with 0 points. Instead, a weighting system applies to the teams' standing at the start of the play-off mini-league. The team finishing fifth in the Super League will start the play-off with 0 points. The fifth placed team's end of season tally of points is subtracted from the sum of the points that other teams have. This number is then divided by five.
